commit.subject: Merge main (through #389) into decode stack
commit.body:
Resolves the conflict with main's #375 refactor by unifying env-var
decode/maskClaims into buildMaskedEnvVars() in credential-mask-env.ts:
claim sentinels are keyed env:<NAME>#<claim>, the whole rebuilt token is
registered via registerWithSentinel, and getCredentialRestrictions'
env loop is deny-only. extractAndSubstitute lives in
credential-extract.ts with the decode-era sentinel === cap guard.
Env schema entries carry extract/onExtractNoMatch (from #375) plus
decode/maskClaims (from this stack).

Reuses the resolution recorded on the local cred-mask-integration
branch (merge 18b592b), re-verified against current main — main's
post-snapshot additions (CRL_PATH import, windows sandboxUser schema,
seccomp-notify, mitm-ca, winsrt work) are all preserved.
commit.author: elhajjj

commit.subject: Merge main (#333 onExtractNoMatch) into decode: jwt
commit.body:
Composition decision: with decode: "jwt", the "nothing was masked" case
(pattern matched nothing, or no regex candidate survived JWT
verification) now routes through the entry's onExtractNoMatch policy
from #333 (warn / deny / error, default warn) instead of the hardcoded
fail-open warning this branch originally shipped. Both conditions are
the same "masking cannot apply" state, so they take the same
operator-configured posture; the warning/error text distinguishes the
decode cause ("matched no verified JWT") from the plain extract cause
("matched nothing").

Also: sandbox-config keeps both new fields (decode + onExtractNoMatch)
with TSDoc updated so onExtractNoMatch documents its decode interaction,
and this branch's buildMaskedFileBinds tests adopt #333's
{binds, degradeToDenyPaths} return shape.
commit.author: elhajjj

commit.subject: Merge main (#361 maskDuplicates) into decode: jwt
commit.body:
Composition decision: one ExtractOptions carries maskDuplicates, and the
decode path threads it through — a decode:"jwt" entry with
maskDuplicates:true also masks verbatim duplicates of VERIFIED JWT
captures, reusing the verified capture's fake JWT without
re-verification (a duplicate is the same value). Unverified candidates
are declined by the callback returning the capture unchanged; the
duplicate pass now skips such identity "sentinels" so unverified values
never mask duplicates and their no-op spans cannot block a verified
capture's verbatim occurrences. Spans are computed against the ORIGINAL
content, so JWT-shaped fakes are safe from re-matching by construction.

Adds two composition tests: a unit test pinning the declined-capture
skip, and a buildMaskedFileBinds test where a verified JWT duplicated in
a comment gets the same fake while a pseudo-JWT and its duplicate stay
untouched.
